d: We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Business Development Officer to help expand our corporate client base, generate new business opportunities, and drive revenue growth.

This is more than a coordination role. You will take an active part in identifying potential clients, opening doors to new partnerships, presenting business solutions, and turning promising leads into successful deals.
You will also play an important role in growing Dawrat, helping businesses discover professional training and development solutions that meet their needs.
If you are confident in dealing with clients, enjoy the challenge of sales, and are motivated by results, we'd like to hear from you!
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Corporate Sales, or a similar role.
Proven ability to generate leads, secure client meetings, present solutions, and close business opportunities.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
Confident, proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable approaching new clients.
Strong commercial awareness and a results-oriented mindset.
Experience in corporate training, professional development, or service-based industries is an added advantage.
Take an active role in expanding the Dawrat's corporate business.
Build valuable relationships with business clients and decision-makers.
Contribute ideas and initiatives that support the growth of Dawrat.
Enjoy a performance-driven, commission-based compensation structure where your business development efforts contribute to your earning opportunities.
r: Generate New Business: Identify, research, and qualify potential corporate clients and business opportunities.
Build Connections: Reach out to prospective clients, schedule meetings, and establish meaningful business relationships.
Present Solutions: Prepare and deliver compelling client presentations, commercial proposals, and quotations.
Convert Opportunities: Follow up with prospects, understand their business needs, negotiate, and convert leads into successful business deals.
Grow Dawrat Corporate: Work closely with the Marketing Department to develop and improve corporate promotions, packages, and special offers.
Develop the Market: Research industry trends, identify potential partnerships, and explore new revenue opportunities.
Drive Results: Maintain an active sales pipeline and provide regular updates on leads, meetings, conversions, and business development performance.

d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
q: At least 2 years experience working within a retail environment

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.
r: At Chalhoub we express the exceptional! As a Fashion Consultant you will be responsible for achieving individual and collective sales targets while delivering exceptional Guest Experience; and ensuring support in the implementation of CRM, CX and other key customer and people initiatives in-store.
You will collect data on customer behaviour, top sellers, slow movers which will be key input for business reviews
Drive client relationships within an omni-channel approach
Drive eNPS through people experience initiatives and culture
Ensure adherence to VM guidelines and Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Ensure click and collect are conducted within SLAs (Service-level agreement)
Ensure customer data is properly captured in adherence to marketing team requirements
Promote loyalty program (MUSE) and stay up-to-date with app offerings etc..
Support with in-store marketing events and activations
Keep abreast of all brand social media activities and campaigns
Provide input to what’s working well/what’s not working well within the store

d: PAX is seeking an experienced and commercially minded Legal Counsel to support its growing UAE operations.

This is a hands-on in-house role covering commercial contracting, distribution and agency arrangements, employment compliance, corporate governance, intellectual property, regulatory matters and dispute resolution. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Finance, HR, Compliance and senior management to provide practical legal advice and manage legal risks across the business.
The ideal candidate will have strong UAE legal experience, excellent English drafting and negotiation skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-growing business environment.

Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of English commercial agreements, including distribution, agency, reseller, supply, procurement, marketing, service, consultancy, NDA and partnership agreements.
Advise the business on UAE Commercial Agencies Law, distribution structures, exclusivity, distributor protection, termination rights and contractual risk.
Support Sales and business teams on customer, supplier, distributor and channel-related contracts.
Identify key legal and commercial risks and recommend practical mitigation measures.
Develop, maintain and improve standard contract templates, legal guidelines and approval processes.
Support contract management and ensure proper execution, record keeping and compliance with internal approval requirements.
Advise HR and management on UAE Federal Labour Law and applicable employment regulations.
Draft and review employment contracts, consultancy agreements, confidentiality agreements, restrictive covenants, warning letters and termination documents.
Support HR in managing employee relations, disciplinary matters, investigations, grievances and employee disputes.
Identify and mitigate employment-related legal risks throughout the employee lifecycle.
Review HR policies and procedures to ensure legal compliance and practical implementation.
Support the governance and ongoing legal compliance of UAE entities and free-zone companies.
Coordinate corporate document processing, licence renewals, shareholder and board resolutions, powers of attorney and corporate records.
Support UBO declarations, regulatory filings and economic substance-related compliance, where applicable.
Advise on the legal differences between UAE mainland and free-zone structures.
Liaise with government authorities, free-zone authorities, external legal counsel and corporate service providers when required.
Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and advise management on their potential impact.
Provide day-to-day legal advice on business operations, marketing activities, commercial practices, product-related matters and corporate governance.
Review marketing and promotional materials from a legal and regulatory perspective.
Support compliance with applicable consumer protection, advertising, product and trading requirements.
Establish practical legal risk-control mechanisms and improve internal legal processes.
Provide clear, commercially practical and business-oriented legal solutions to internal stakeholders.
Manage the company’s local intellectual property portfolio, including trademarks and other relevant rights.
Support IP registration, renewals, licensing and brand protection matters.
Coordinate anti-counterfeiting and infringement enforcement activities.
Work with external counsel and relevant authorities on IP disputes and enforcement actions.
Manage commercial disputes from initial assessment through negotiation, settlement, litigation or arbitration.
Advise management on claims, contractual remedies, settlement strategies and dispute risks.
Prepare legal notices, settlement documents and dispute-related correspondence.
Coordinate with external counsel and manage litigation strategy, timelines, costs and outcomes.
Support the preservation of evidence and relevant contractual and corporate records.
Bachelor’s degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification. An LLM or overseas law degree is preferred.
At least 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantial hands-on experience in the UAE.
In-house legal experience in the UAE or the Middle East is strongly preferred.
Strong practical knowledge of UAE commercial contracts, distribution arrangements and commercial agency regulations.
Experience with agency, distribution, reseller, supply, procurement and service agreements.
Good understanding of UAE Federal Labour Law and employment compliance.
Familiarity with UAE mainland and free-zone legal and corporate structures.
Practical experience with DIFC or ADGM legal frameworks is highly preferred.
Experience in corporate governance, regulatory filings, entity maintenance and legal risk management.
Proven experience in commercial dispute resolution, litigation, arbitration or external counsel management.
Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, retail, distribution, trading or other regulated industries is an advantage.
Excellent legal drafting, negotiation, analytical and communication skills.
Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to independently prepare and negotiate English legal documents.
Strong commercial awareness, sound judgement and a practical, solutions-oriented approach.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with business teams.
Ability to work on-site in Dubai.

At Lendo, we are a fast-growing FinTech company on a mission to transform the financial landscape in Saudi Arabia. Through our innovative digital lending platform, we empower businesses by offering fast, secure, and transparent access to finance. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented Relationship Manager to join our team and play a pivotal role in building and nurturing client relationships. If you’re passionate about client engagement, business development, and providing tailored financial solutions in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you!
q: Proven experience as a Relationship Manager or similar role in financial services, FinTech, or a related industry, with 2 to 5 years of relevant experience.
Strong understanding of financial products and services, with the ability to learn and adapt to new solutions quickly.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on client engagement and satisfaction.
Ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize workload effectively.
Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and solving client issues.
Goal-oriented, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
r: Maintain a deep knowledge of Lendo’s products and services, staying updated on new offerings and industry trends.
Build and sustain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients, becoming their go-to resource for financial solutions.
Conduct regular site visits and e-meetings with clients to maintain engagement and support.
Research and pursue new business opportunities to expand Lendo's client portfolio.
Identify and evaluate potential clients to assess compatibility with Lendo’s products and services.
Upsell and cross-sell relevant products and services, enhancing value for clients while contributing to revenue targets.
Identify and understand clients' needs, goals, and challenges, recommending tailored solutions to address these.
Provide clients with in-depth product and service consultations, guiding them through the decision-making process.
Ensure client satisfaction by delivering a seamless onboarding experience and ongoing support.
Meet and exceed sales and revenue targets by actively managing client accounts and leveraging opportunities for growth.
Track and report on client engagement and revenue performance, providing insights to the sales team.
Address client concerns, issues, and complaints with efficiency and professionalism, ensuring timely resolution to maintain high levels of satisfaction.
Foster long-term loyalty and trust with clients by providing consistent, reliable support.
